description: This is a PHP source file implementing an API endpoint class 'LocationAPI' within the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system. The class provides CRUD operations for 'Location' entities, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting location data via REST API endpoints, with integrated validation, service layer interaction, and OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: LocationAPI
